description:
Istanbul Medipol University adopts the principle of raising individuals who have gained permanent advantages, focused on science and technology production, and can respond to the changing needs of society, with the education it provides and the differences it adds, and it accepts as a duty to contribute to society and universal science.

Medipol University, which aims to be a leading university that directs science and society with its strong corporate culture, entrepreneurial spirit, and dynamism open to continuous development, is among the shining universities of Turkey with its environmentally sensitive structure, tolerant perspective, and perfectionist attitude.

Medipol University, with its campuses in various districts of Istanbul, has adopted a university approach that spreads throughout the city. This university, which has many campuses in a metropolitan city, stands out with its structure. In order to look at life at Medipol University, it is necessary to evaluate all campuses separately. The 3 campuses of Medipol University and the life at the university, in general, are as follows:

Medipol University Hospital in Bagcilar, where students receive practical lessons and internship training, stands out with its central location and a giant training complex.

The Medipol University Hospital in Bağcılar, where students receive practical lessons and internship training, stands out with its central location on the side of the TEM Highway and being a giant training complex. Medipol University Hospital, which includes 4 hospitals as General, Oncology, Cardiovascular Surgery, and Dental Hospital, offers practical training to Medipol students with its 470-bed capacity, 133 intensive care units, 246 polyclinic rooms, and 25 operating rooms.
